name: Large Soran'ruk Fragment
summary: The Large Soran'ruk Fragment rests in Shadowfang Keep, far from the other shards. Its broken orb once held a disgraced demon of the Burning Legion.

sections.title: The Legacy of Soran'ruk
sections.body: Disgraced demons of the Burning Legion may be condemned to imprisonment in enchanted orbs. Mages and warlocks aligned with the Legion receive these vessels and draw on the fel forces trapped within. Even when an orb is shattered, its bound fiend's lingering essence still radiates power. Each fragment draws ambitious practitioners of shadow magic.

sections.title: The Shard in Shadowfang
sections.body: The orb of Soran'ruk was cracked into two halves long ago. Cultists elsewhere scattered one half into smaller pieces. A sorcerer in the cursed Shadowfang Keep claimed the larger half. The Shadowfang Darksouls carry the Large Soran'ruk Fragment, which holds the bound spirit until someone seeks to reforge the ancient vessel.

faq.q: What is the Large Soran'ruk Fragment?
faq.answer: The Large Soran'ruk Fragment is the larger half of the Orb of Soran'ruk, an ancient vessel holding the bound spirit of a disgraced Burning Legion demon.

aliases: where do i find the large fragment
faq.answer: The Shadowfang Darksouls hold the fragment in Shadowfang Keep, a haunted fortress in Silverpine Forest.

The original orb was split into two main pieces. The smaller half was broken into shards and carried to the coastal caverns of Blackfathom Deeps, while dark wizards kept the larger half in Shadowfang Keep.
Doan Karhan, a reclusive hermit in the southern Barrens, has devoted his life to studying and reconstructing the lost orbs of the Burning Legion.

angles.text: Reclaiming the Large Soran'ruk Fragment lets you master the trapped demonic spirit inside and aid Doan Karhan in reconstructing a potent weapon for demonic arts.
